const axios = require('axios')
const cheerio = require('cheerio')

async function scrapeSoundClouds(query) {
  try {
    const url = \`https://m.soundcloud.com/search?q=${encodeURIComponent(query)}\`
    const { data } = await axios.get(url, {
      headers: {
        'User-Agent': 'Mozilla/5.0 (Linux; Android 10; K) AppleWebKit/537.36 (KHTML, like Gecko) Chrome/124.0.0.0 Mobile Safari/537.36',
        'Accept-Language': 'id-ID,id;q=0.9,en-US;q=0.8,en;q=0.7',
        'Referer': 'https://m.soundcloud.com/',
        'Origin': 'https://m.soundcloud.com'
      }
    })

    const $ = cheerio.load(data)
    const results = []

    $('.List_VerticalList__2uQYU li').each((i, el) => {
      const title = $(el).find('.Cell_CellLink__3yLVS').attr('aria-label')
      const path = $(el).find('.Cell_CellLink__3yLVS').attr('href')
      if (title && path) {
        results.push({
          title,
          url: 'https://m.soundcloud.com' + path
        })
      }
    })

    return {
      status: true,
      creator: 'azam',
      results: results.slice(0, 5)
    }
  } catch (err) {
    return { status: false, message: 'Error: ' + err.message }
  }
}
